hook: In 2004, email was a solved problem until Google's engineer changed it forever.
body: Back then, Gmail felt like a new idea in an old world of Outlook and Hotmail. An engineer at Google had a vision for something better: simplicity through innovation. He introduced features like labels and the ability to reply all, transforming email from cluttered to organized. This wasn't just about inbox management; it was about how we interact with information. Gmail's success led to countless innovations in user experience design.
cta: Clone this repo for more insights into Google's email revolution.
